$comment: Documented exceptions for scripts/check-design-utilities.mjs (Plan 217). Each entry names a file, the class or declaration as the guard prints it, and the reason no token owns it. An entry that matches nothing fails the check. A reason that starts with "Open (Plan 217)" is a design value with no token yet, waiting on an owner decision; the others are geometry or system behaviour.

allow.reason: Open (Plan 217): distance of the link variant's underline from the text. Needs a component token (button.link.underline-offset) or a decision to keep the Tailwind value.
Open (Plan 217): the loading spinner's rotation. A named Tailwind animation (one turn per second, linear); it waits on the parked motion system.
Open (Plan 217): the skeleton's pulse. A named Tailwind animation (two seconds, opacity to 0.5); it waits on the parked motion system.
Open (Plan 217): easing curve of the indicator's slide. It waits on the parked motion system, which has duration tokens and no easing tokens.
Open (Plan 217): easing curve of the sheet's slide (see progress.tsx).
The indicator's offset is the progress value itself (translateX(-(100 - value)%)): a runtime measurement, not a design value.
Open (Plan 217): hover zoom of a grid item. Needs a component token or a decision to drop the effect.
Open (Plan 217): hover lift of a grid item (see scale-105).
Open (Plan 217): hover zoom of a feature item. Needs a component token or a decision to drop the effect.
Open (Plan 217): hover zoom of the feature icon container (see scale-105).
Open (Plan 217): hover tilt of the feature icon container (see scale-105).
Open (Plan 217): the selected value truncates to one line. A behaviour count; needs a token only if the line count is meant to change.
Open (Plan 217): the popper's 0.25rem nudge away from the trigger on the top and bottom sides. Needs a component token (select.content.offset) or sideOffset.
Open (Plan 217): the popper's 0.25rem nudge on the left and right sides (see translate-y-1).
Open (Plan 217): blur behind the dialog overlay. Tailwind's sm is 8px; there is no token and no Figma background blur yet.
Open (Plan 217): blur behind the sheet overlay (see dialog.tsx).
Open (Plan 217): blur behind the sticky header (see dialog.tsx). Tailwind's default is 8px.
Flips the chevron when the item opens: orientation geometry, not a design value.
Flips the chevron when the menu opens (see accordion.tsx).
Turns the arrow's square into a diamond: shape geometry, not a design value.
Turns the handle grip upright in a vertical group: orientation geometry, not a design value.
Open (Plan 217): hover fade of the native search-clear and date-picker icons, 150ms. Needs a component token (input.native-icon.transition-duration).
prefers-reduced-motion: cuts every animation to an instant so Radix still gets animationend. A system accessibility behaviour, not a designer-owned value.
prefers-reduced-motion: see animation-duration.
